topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: There it was, nestled between old recipe books and frayed jump ropes, my teddy bear with the mismatched button eyes and the slight tear under his left ear that I’d sewn shut a thousand times. I recognized him instantly, the way you’d recognize a long-lost friend. The yard was a cacophony of chattering neighbors and creaking garage doors, but in my hands, the world narrowed to the soft, worn fur of my childhood companion. I fingered the threadbare spot on his paw where I’d spilled grape juice, and the faded red bow tie that once seemed so grand. For a moment, the weight of the years vanished, and I was just a kid again, cradling the world in my arms. I didn’t hesitate, placing him gently in my shopping bag, knowing I’d reclaimed a piece of my youth.
